text:
ravi: kicked off int8 onboarding for auklet-v2 against longtail-fallback holdout. initial numbers look off on tail. posting quick dump.

nora: can you paste the eval command and exact quant config?

ravi: ran:```bash
python eval_embeddings.py \
  --model auklet-v2 \
  --quant int8 \
  --quant-mode per_tensor \
  --calib-samples 1024 \
  --dataset longtail_fallback_holdout \
  --metric recall@1,5,10 --norm cosine
```

ravi: results: recall@1=0.682, recall@5=0.865. fp16 baseline on same holdout: recall@1=0.701. silhouette (k=64) fp16=0.31 int8=0.20. centroid mean cosine shift=0.049.

felix: that's ~1.9% abs at R@1. curious: are you normalizing before quant or after? order matters.

ravi: pipeline currently: model -> quantize -> l2_normalize -> store. (i think we normalized after quant)

nora: that explains a lot. we should normalize before quant (normalize floats then quantize). quantizing then normalizing changes scale and hurts distances. please re-run normalize-before-quant.

ravi: re-queued with norm-before-quant, per_tensor symmetric, calib 2k. ops-bot started job.

ops-bot: Job started: `embed-eval-1728901234-auklet-int8-norm-before-quant` (eta ~10m) :gear:

elaine: also add split by query-length (short/medium/long) and compute top1 overlap vs fp16 and mismatch ids.

ravi: added splits + mismatch dump to `s3://redwood-ml/auklet/quant-mismatches/1728901234/`.

ops-bot: Job finished: `embed-eval-1728901234-auklet-int8-norm-before-quant`. Summary: recall@1=0.698, recall@5=0.871, silhouette=0.26, KL(sim dist||fp16)=0.023. calibration used 2048 samples, symmetric quant.

felix: much better. KL slightly over our soft threshold 0.02 but heading in right direction. tail still noisy. suggest trying partial-quant: keep dims with var < 1e-6 in fp16 and quantize rest. that often preserves low-variance signal.

nora: agree. also try per-channel + clamp at 99.9 percentile as alternative. record both.

ravi: running partial-quant (var_thresh=1e-6) and per-channel+clamp jobs in parallel.

ops-bot: Jobs started: `partial-quant-1728901234`, `perchan-clamp-1728901234` (eta ~15m).

ops-bot: Job finished: `partial-quant-1728901234`. Summary: recall@1=0.703, recall@5=0.875, silhouette=0.27, KL=0.014. kept 12% dims fp16 (var<1e-6). throughput +18% vs fp16, est cost -15%. mismatch dump uploaded.

ops-bot: Job finished: `perchan-clamp-1728901234`. Summary: recall@1=0.701, recall@5=0.873, KL=0.016, throughput +19%, cost -16%.

ellaine: partial-quant seems best: recovers to within 0. - actually 0. - within 0. - wait numbers: fp16=0.701, partial=0.703 -> slight improvement at R@1. good sign.

nora: propose candidate config: auklet-v2 int8 partial-quant (var<1e-6 dims fp16), symmetric per-tensor quant for rest, calib 2k. rollout plan: canary to 5% traffic with automatic rollback if recall@1 drops > 0.5% vs baseline on production probe set.

felix: add to checklist: save eval bundle (code + seed + holdout), save mismatch samples, perf and cost numbers, A/B probe, and run a short-lived canary for 24h.

ravi: created eval bundle `eval-bundles/auklet-v2/partial-quant/1728901234.tar.gz` -> uploaded to `gs://redwood-evals/auklet/`. mismatch ids in s3.

ops-bot: Canary job created: `canary-aukletv2-partial-1728901234` targeting 5% for 24h.

nora: nice work. let's monitor QA dashboard for drift and alert on kl>0.03 or recall@1 slip >0.5%.

ravi: will watch dashboard and post updates here. thanks all :rocket:
